name: slashloop
description: Viral short-form video research: track sources, find outliers, run Gemini video analysis, and turn winners into hooks, ideas, and creative briefs.

databaseUrl.title: Database location (optional)
databaseUrl.description: SQLite path for slashloop data. Leave BLANK to use ~/.slashloop/slashloop.db (recommended). To override, use the file: prefix with an absolute path, e.g. file:/Users/me/slashloop.db.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Powers AI analysis, hook variation, and brief generation. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

apifyApiKey.title: Apify API key
apifyApiKey.description: Powers live TikTok scraping. Get one at https://console.apify.com/account/integrations. Optional for read-only/mock use.

spendCapCents.title: Apify monthly spend cap (cents)
spendCapCents.description: Hard cap on Apify spend per month. Default 500 = $5.
